newsitem.title: USA: State St, others form Merrimack Fund.
newsitem.headline: State St, others form Merrimack Fund.

text.p: State Street Bank, BankBoston and Prudential Investments said they formed the Merrimack Fund Llc to provide long-term funding for the asset-backed securities industry.

With initial funded capital of $150 million, Merrimack will make loans to, or debt investments in, specialized finance companies which originate and service specific types of consumer assets and which use securitization as part of their long term funding strategy, the three said in a news release.
The three partners said they will share management of the fund and State Street will act as its administrative agent.

With the combined contributions of State Street and the other partners, State Street said it expects to typically make financing commitments in the $5-50 million range, and will be able to complete individual transactions of up to $100 million.
